# OpsAutomated

> OpsAutomated is an automation agency that builds, runs and maintains AI agents for small UK recruitment agencies, on top of the ATS and tools they already use. Outcome: more placements without adding payroll.

- Website: https://opsautomated.co.uk/
- Contact: jamie@opsautomated.co.uk
- Book a call: https://calendar.app.google/a3V7NKaze5B8Ru9L6
- Location: London, UK. Clients across the UK.

## Agents
- Resourcer: reads, scores and files every inbound application in the ATS the minute it lands; acknowledges the candidate once a consultant approves.
- Hunter: finds clients hiring in the agency's patch, names the decision maker, drafts the opening line.
- Sourcer: matches new roles against the agency's existing candidate database before paying job boards again.
- Coordinator: CV formatting, interview scheduling, feedback and reference chasing.
- Librarian: keeps the ATS current - activity logged, statuses updated, duplicates merged, consent chased.

## Works with
Zoho Recruit, Bullhorn, JobAdder, Vincere, Recruit CRM, Firefish, Loxo.
